verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד אַחְאָב֙ לְאִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֛ג אֶת־ כָּל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ ’aḥ·’āḇ lə·’î·ze·ḇel ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’ê·lî·yā·hū wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer hā·raḡ ’eṯ- kāl- han·nə·ḇî·’îm be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah had done and how he had killed - all the prophets with the sword
verses.literalPt: E ACABE fez saber a Jezabel tudo quanto Elias havia feito, e como totalmente matara todos os profetas à espada.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַ֤ח אִיזֶ֙בֶל֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה־ יַעֲשׂ֤וּן אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִפ֔וּן כִּֽי־ כָעֵ֤ת מָחָר֙ אָשִׂ֣ים אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁךָ֔ כְּנֶ֖פֶשׁ אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·laḥ ’î·ze·ḇel mal·’āḵ ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū lê·mōr kōh- ya·‘ă·śūn ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōh yō·w·si·p̄ūn kî- ḵā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- nap̄·šə·ḵā kə·ne·p̄eš ’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem
verses.literal: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah saying May the gods deal with me and ever so severely if by this time tomorrow I have not made your life like the lives of those you killed . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Jezabel mandou um mensageiro a Elias, a dizer-lhe: Assim me façam os deuses, e outro tanto, se de certo amanhã a estas horas não puser a tua vida como a de um deles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕א בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּנַּ֥ח אֶֽת־ נַעֲר֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- nap̄·šōw way·yā·ḇō bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ’ă·šer lî·hū·ḏāh way·yan·naḥ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rōw šām
verses.literal: And Elijah was afraid . . . and ran for his life When he came to Beersheba in Judah he left his servant there
verses.literalPt: O que vendo ele, se levantou e, para escapar com vida, se foi, e chegando a Berseba, que é de Judá, deixou ali o seu servo.

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הָלַ֤ךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ י֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיֵּ֕שֶׁב תַּ֖חַת רֹ֣תֶם אֶחָת וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל אֶת־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ לָמ֔וּת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ רַ֗ב עַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֔י כִּֽי־ לֹא־ ט֥וֹב אָנֹכִ֖י מֵאֲבֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hā·laḵ bam·miḏ·bār de·reḵ yō·wm way·yā·ḇō way·yê·šeḇ ta·ḥaṯ rō·ṯem ʾɛ·ḥå̄ṯ way·yiš·’al ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw lā·mūṯ way·yō·mer raḇ ‘at·tāh Yah·weh qaḥ nap̄·šî kî- lō- ṭō·wḇ ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·’ă·ḇō·ṯāy
verses.literal: while he himself went a day’s . . . journey into the wilderness He sat down under a broom tree and prayed that he might die I have had enough . . . LORD he said Take my life for I am no better than my fathers
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, foi ao deserto, caminho de um dia, e foi sentar-se debaixo de um zimbro; e pediu para si a morte, e disse: Já basta, ó SENHOR; toma agora a minha vida, pois não sou melhor do que meus pais.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ וַיִּישַׁ֔ן תַּ֖חַת רֹ֣תֶם אֶחָ֑ד וְהִנֵּֽה־ זֶ֤ה מַלְאָךְ֙ נֹגֵ֣עַ בּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ ק֥וּם אֱכֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ way·yî·šan ta·ḥaṯ rō·ṯem ’e·ḥāḏ wə·hin·nêh- zeh mal·’āḵ nō·ḡê·a‘ bōw way·yō·mer lōw qūm ’ĕ·ḵō·wl
verses.literal: Then he lay down under the broom tree and fell asleep . . . Suddenly . . . an angel touched him and said Get up and eat
verses.literalPt: E deitou-se, e dormiu debaixo do zimbro; e eis que então um anjo o tocou, e lhe disse: Levanta-te, come.

verses.original: וַיַּבֵּ֕ט וְהִנֵּ֧ה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָ֛יו עֻגַ֥ת רְצָפִ֖ים וְצַפַּ֣חַת מָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yab·bêṭ wə·hin·nêh mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw ‘u·ḡaṯ rə·ṣā·p̄îm wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ mā·yim way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yā·šāḇ way·yiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: And he looked around and there by his head was a cake of bread baked over hot coals and a jar of water So he ate and drank and lay down again
verses.literalPt: E olhou, e eis que à sua cabeceira estava um pão cozido sobre as brasas, e uma botija de água; e comeu, e bebeu, e tornou a deitar-se.

verses.original: וַיָּשָׁב֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה׀ שֵׁנִית֙ וַיִּגַּע־ בּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר ק֣וּם אֱכֹ֑ל כִּ֛י רַ֥ב מִמְּךָ֖ הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh šê·nîṯ way·yig·ga‘- bōw way·yō·mer qūm ’ĕ·ḵōl kî raḇ mim·mə·ḵā had·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: A second time the angel of the LORD returned and touched him saying Get up and eat . . . or the journey will be too much for you
verses.literalPt: E o anjo do SENHOR tornou segunda vez, e o tocou, e disse: Levanta-te e come, porque te será muito longo o caminho.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּכֹ֣חַ׀ הָאֲכִילָ֣ה הַהִ֗יא אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה עַ֛ד הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yō·ḵal way·yiš·teh way·yê·leḵ bə·ḵō·aḥ hā·’ă·ḵî·lāh ha·hî ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh ‘aḏ har hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥō·rêḇ
verses.literal: So he got up and ate and drank And strengthened by that food he walked forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb the mountain of God
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se, pois, e comeu e bebeu; e com a força daquela comida caminhou quarenta dias e quarenta noites até Horebe, o monte de Deus.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא־ שָׁ֥ם אֶל־ הַמְּעָרָ֖ה וַיָּ֣לֶן שָׁ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מַה־ לְּךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō- šām ’el- ham·mə·‘ā·rāh way·yā·len šām wə·hin·nêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer lōw mah- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: There . . . Elijah entered . . . . . . a cave and spent the night And the word of the LORD came to him saying What are you doing here Elijah
verses.literalPt: E ali entrou numa caverna e passou ali a noite; e eis que a palavra do SENHOR veio a ele, e lhe disse: Que fazes aqui Elias?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַיהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת כִּֽי־ עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣יךָ הָרָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ הָרְג֣וּ בֶחָ֑רֶב וָֽאִוָּתֵ֤ר אֲנִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qan·nō qin·nê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî- ‘ā·zə·ḇū ḇə·rî·ṯə·ḵā bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā hā·rā·sū wə·’eṯ- nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā hā·rə·ḡū ḇe·ḥā·reḇ wā·’iw·wā·ṯêr ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî way·ḇaq·šū ’eṯ- nap̄·šî lə·qaḥ·tāh
verses.literal: I have been very zealous . . . for the LORD the God of Hosts he replied but the Israelites . . . have forsaken Your covenant torn down Your altars and killed Your prophets with the sword I am the only one left and they are seeking - my life as well
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Tenho sido muito zeloso pelo SENHOR Deus dos Exércitos, porque os filhos de Israel deixaram a tua aliança, derrubaram os teus altares, e mataram os teus profetas à espada, e só eu fiquei, e buscam a minha vida para ma tirarem.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר צֵ֣א וְעָמַדְתָּ֣ בָהָר֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֣ה עֹבֵ֗ר וְר֣וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֡ה וְחָזָ֞ק מְפָרֵק֩ הָרִ֨ים וּמְשַׁבֵּ֤ר סְלָעִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א בָר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַחַ֤ר הָר֨וּחַ רַ֔עַשׁ לֹ֥א בָרַ֖עַשׁ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ṣê wə·‘ā·maḏ·tā ḇā·hār lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh Yah·weh ‘ō·ḇêr wə·rū·aḥ gə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·ḥā·zāq mə·p̄ā·rêq hā·rîm ū·mə·šab·bêr sə·lā·‘îm lip̄·nê Yah·weh lō ḇā·rū·aḥ Yah·weh wə·’a·ḥar hå̄·rū·aḥ ra·‘aš lō ḇā·ra·‘aš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD Behold the LORD is about to pass by And a great and mighty wind tore into the mountains and shattered the rocks before the LORD but the LORD was not in the wind After the wind there was an earthquake but the LORD was not in the earthquake
verses.literalPt: E Deus lhe disse: Sai para fora, e põe-te neste monte perante o SENHOR. E eis que passava o SENHOR, como também um grande e forte vento que fendia os montes e quebrava as penhas diante do SENHOR; porém o SENHOR não estava no vento; e depois do vento um terremoto; também o SENHOR não estava no terremoto;

verses.original: וְאַחַ֤ר הָרַ֙עַשׁ֙ אֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בָאֵ֖שׁ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַחַ֣ר הָאֵ֔שׁ ק֖וֹל דְּמָמָ֥ה דַקָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar hā·ra·‘aš ’êš lō ḇā·’êš Yah·weh wə·’a·ḥar hā·’êš qō·wl də·mā·māh ḏaq·qāh
verses.literal: After the earthquake there was a fire but the LORD was not in the fire And after the fire came a still small voice
verses.literalPt: E depois do terremoto um fogo; porém também o SENHOR não estava no fogo; e depois do fogo uma voz mansa e delicada.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיָּ֤לֶט פָּנָיו֙ בְּאַדַּרְתּ֔וֹ וַיֵּצֵ֕א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הַמְּעָרָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ ק֔וֹל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־ לְּךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·yā·leṭ pā·nāw bə·’ad·dar·tōw way·yê·ṣê way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ pe·ṯaḥ ham·mə·‘ā·rāh wə·hin·nêh ’ê·lāw qō·wl way·yō·mer mah- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: When Elijah heard it he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave Suddenly a voice came to him and said What are you doing here Elijah
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo-a Elias, envolveu o seu rosto na sua capa, e saiu para fora, e pôs-se à entrada da caverna; e eis que veio a ele uma voz, que dizia: Que fazes aqui, Elias?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַיהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת כִּֽי־ עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣יךָ הָרָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ הָרְג֣וּ בֶחָ֑רֶב וָאִוָּתֵ֤ר אֲנִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qan·nō qin·nê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî- ‘ā·zə·ḇū ḇə·rî·ṯə·ḵā bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā hā·rā·sū wə·’eṯ- nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā hā·rə·ḡū ḇe·ḥā·reḇ wā·’iw·wā·ṯêr ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî way·ḇaq·šū ’eṯ- nap̄·šî lə·qaḥ·tāh
verses.literal: I have been very zealous . . . for the LORD the God of Hosts he replied but the Israelites . . . have forsaken Your covenant torn down Your altars and killed Your prophets with the sword I am the only one left and they are seeking - my life as well
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Eu tenho sido em extremo zeloso pelo SENHOR Deus dos Exércitos, porque os filhos de Israel deixaram a tua aliança, derrubaram os teus altares, e mataram os teus profetas à espada, e só eu fiquei; e buscam a minha vida para ma tirarem.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו לֵ֛ךְ שׁ֥וּב לְדַרְכְּךָ֖ מִדְבַּ֣רָה דַמָּ֑שֶׂק וּבָ֗אתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֧ אֶת־ חֲזָאֵ֛ל לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw lêḵ šūḇ lə·ḏar·kə·ḵā miḏ·ba·rāh ḏam·må̄·śɛq ū·ḇā·ṯā ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ḥă·zā·’êl lə·me·leḵ ‘al- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to him Go back by the way you came and go to the Desert of Damascus When you arrive you are to anoint Hazael as king over Aram
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR lhe disse: Vai, volta pelo teu caminho para o deserto de Damasco; e, chegando lá, unge a Hazael rei sobre a Síria.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ נִמְשִׁ֔י תִּמְשַׁ֥ח לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־ אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָט֙ מֵאָבֵ֣ל מְחוֹלָ֔ה תִּמְשַׁ֥ח לְנָבִ֖יא תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ yê·hū ḇen- nim·šî tim·šaḥ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ mê·’ā·ḇêl mə·ḥō·w·lāh tim·šaḥ lə·nā·ḇî taḥ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: You are also to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel and Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel-meholah . . . to succeed you as prophet
verses.literalPt: Também a Jeú, filho de Ninsi, ungirás rei de Israel; e também a Eliseu, filho de Safate de Abel-Meolá, ungirás profeta em teu lugar.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה הַנִּמְלָ֛ט מֵחֶ֥רֶב חֲזָאֵ֖ל יָמִ֣ית יֵה֑וּא וְהַנִּמְלָ֛ט מֵחֶ֥רֶב יֵה֖וּא יָמִ֥ית אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·nim·lāṭ mê·ḥe·reḇ ḥă·zā·’êl yā·mîṯ yê·hū wə·han·nim·lāṭ mê·ḥe·reḇ yê·hū yā·mîṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā‘
verses.literal: Then Jehu will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Hazael and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Jehu
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que o que escapar da espada de Hazael, matá-lo-á Jeú; e o que escapar da espada de Jeú, matá-lo-á Eliseu.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֥י בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל־ הַבִּרְכַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ כָֽרְעוּ֙ לַבַּ֔עַל וְכָ֨ל־ הַפֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ נָשַׁ֖ק לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·’ar·tî ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kāl- hab·bir·ka·yim ’ă·šer lō- ḵā·rə·‘ū lab·ba·‘al wə·ḵāl hap·peh ’ă·šer lō- nā·šaq lōw
verses.literal: Nevertheless, I have reserved seven thousand in Israel all whose knees have not bowed to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him
verses.literalPt: Também deixei ficar em Israel sete mil: todos os joelhos que não se dobraram a Baal, e toda a boca que não o beijou.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִ֠שָּׁם וַיִּמְצָ֞א אֶת־ אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָט֙ וְה֣וּא חֹרֵ֔שׁ שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֤ר צְמָדִים֙ לְפָנָ֔יו וְה֖וּא בִּשְׁנֵ֣ים הֶעָשָׂ֑ר וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אַדַּרְתּ֖וֹ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ wə·hū ḥō·rêš šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ṣə·mā·ḏîm lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·hū biš·nêm he·‘ā·śār way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ê·lāw way·yaš·lêḵ ’ad·dar·tōw ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: So Elijah departed . . . and found Elisha son of Shaphat He was plowing with twelve . . . teams of oxen and he was with the twelfth team . . . Elijah passed by him and threw his cloak around him
verses.literalPt: Partiu, pois, Elias dali, e achou a Eliseu, filho de Safate, que andava lavrando com doze juntas de bois adiante dele, e ele estava com a duodécima; e Elias passou por ele, e lançou a sua capa sobre ele.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ הַבָּקָ֗ר וַיָּ֙רָץ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶשְּׁקָה־ נָּא֙ לְאָבִ֣י וּלְאִמִּ֔י וְאֵלְכָ֖ה אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ לֵ֣ךְ שׁ֔וּב כִּ֥י מֶה־ עָשִׂ֖יתִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- hab·bā·qār way·yā·rāṣ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’eš·šə·qāh- nā lə·’ā·ḇî ū·lə·’im·mî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā way·yō·mer lōw lêḵ šūḇ kî meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lāḵ
verses.literal: So Elisha left the oxen ran after Elijah and said Please let me kiss my father and mother goodbye and then I will follow you Go on back Elijah replied for what have I done to you
verses.literalPt: Então deixou ele os bois, e correu após Elias; e disse: Deixa-me beijar a meu pai e a minha mãe, e então te seguirei. E ele lhe disse: Vai, e volta; pois, que te fiz eu?

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב מֵאַחֲרָ֜יו וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ צֶ֧מֶד הַבָּקָ֣ר וַיִּזְבָּחֵ֗הוּ וּבִכְלִ֤י הַבָּקָר֙ בִּשְּׁלָ֣ם הַבָּשָׂ֔ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָעָ֖ם וַיֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וַיָּ֗קָם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ וַיְשָׁרְתֵֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mê·’a·ḥă·rāw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ṣe·meḏ hab·bā·qār way·yiz·bā·ḥê·hū ū·ḇiḵ·lî hab·bā·qār biš·šə·lām hab·bā·śār way·yit·tên lā·‘ām way·yō·ḵê·lū way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·šā·rə·ṯê·hū
verses.literal: So Elisha turned back from him took his pair of oxen and slaughtered them Using the oxen’s equipment for fuel he cooked the meat and gave it to the people and they ate Then he set out to follow . . . and serve Elijah
verses.literalPt: Voltou, pois, de o seguir, e tomou a junta de bois, e os matou, e com os aparelhos dos bois cozeu as carnes, e as deu ao povo, e comeram; então se levantou e seguiu a Elias, e o servia.
